about: Vendor bulk upload bugs found by the QA platform on the UAT sandbox (GMMCO 47053 / PROCOL DEMO 198678), 29 Sep 2026. A failing VBU case whose id is listed under a bug is reported as that bug, with its cause and fix. Backend refs: procol-backend origin/main ae36e86894 + PR 16267 @ 65728150bc.

bugs.title: Two identical new vendors in one sheet are both created
bugs.cause: Each row runs in its own background job at the same time and the duplicate check only sees vendors already saved, so rows of one sheet never see each other.
bugs.fix: Drop or fail in-sheet duplicates by the configured key before queueing, or lock per workspace + tax number around the check and the insert.

bugs.title: GST rows fail 'Tax Type not configured for the selected Business Location' at random
bugs.cause: Country.find_by(name: 'India') has no order or status filter; the sandbox has 36 'India' countries and only ids 108 and 270 have an active GST setting.
bugs.fix: Look the mapping up through the active TaxTypeCountryMapping joined on country and tax type names; clean the duplicate countries; check production.

bugs.title: HTTP 500 when excel_data is an empty string
bugs.cause: Only nil is checked; an empty string becomes a 0-byte file and the Roo error is not rescued.
bugs.fix: Treat blank excel_data like missing; rescue every read error as 'Invalid file format'.

bugs.title: HTTP 500 when a Word .docx is uploaded
bugs.cause: A .docx is a valid zip, so Roo's xlsx reader raises an error the helper does not rescue.
bugs.fix: Rescue every read error as 'Invalid file format'.

bugs.title: HTTP 500 on an empty workbook
bugs.cause: last_row is nil for an empty sheet and the loop compares 4 <= nil.
bugs.fix: Return a clear error when the sheet has fewer than 4 rows.

bugs.title: Background job crashes on a tax number whose vendor has city_id 0
bugs.cause: With City/Address blank the invite looks the tax number up and reads existing_company.city.name; city is nil for city_id 0 (BUG-10).
bugs.fix: Fix BUG-10 and guard existing_company.city&.name.

bugs.title: POC 2 name without email: row 'failed' but the vendor was created and invited
bugs.cause: The worker sends the invite first and checks the POC 2 pair afterwards.
bugs.fix: Check the POC 2 name/email pair in the row check, before anything is created.

bugs.title: Required extra fields are not enforced on upload
bugs.cause: The row check builds its column list without extra_fields, while the template passes them.
bugs.fix: Pass the workspace's extra_fields_for_vendor_invite to the row check.

bugs.title: Trailing zeros removed from any text containing a dot ('Plot No. 100' → 'Plot No. 1')
bugs.cause: Every cell goes through strip_trailing_zero, which removes /\.?0+$/ from any value containing a dot.
bugs.fix: Apply it only to numeric cells, or only when the whole value matches /\A\d+\.0+\z/.

bugs.title: Unknown city stored as city_id 0 (a city that does not exist)
bugs.cause: The City column is mapped to city_id and carries the city NAME; when it does not resolve, the text reaches the company and is cast to 0.
bugs.fix: Drop the unresolved city name so the fallback applies (or store null).

bugs.title: Text after a '<' is dropped ('A<B Traders' → 'A')
bugs.cause: Every cell goes through Nokogiri::HTML(val).text, which reads '<B …' as a tag.
bugs.fix: Do not parse cells as HTML; escape on output instead.

bugs.title: Template sample row is shifted against its headers
bugs.cause: Sample values are written by position in the flag-OFF column order.
bugs.fix: Build the sample row from the header list by name.

bugs.title: Vendor Profile dropdown sits on the Business Location column
bugs.cause: vendor_profile_dropdown_range returns a fixed D4:D100 unless vendor_invitation_v2 is on.
bugs.fix: Compute the column from the header list, as Status already is.

bugs.title: Deals In: only the first valid category is checked
bugs.cause: verify_deals_in returns 'valid' on the first good code and never checks the rest.
bugs.fix: Check every code; fail on the first bad one.

bugs.title: Account Group accepts values that are not in its dropdown
bugs.cause: Extra fields are copied into companies.misc with no check of dropdown_options.
bugs.fix: For type dropdown fields, refuse values that are not an option value.

bugs.title: City 'a' is matched to '24 PARAGANAS NORTH'
bugs.cause: With no exact match the lookup takes the first city whose name contains the text.
bugs.fix: Exact (case-insensitive) match only, or refuse ambiguous partial matches.

bugs.title: A sheet with no vendor rows answers success and creates nothing
bugs.cause: Column names are always read from row 3 and vendors from row 4, with no check that any were found.
bugs.fix: Refuse when no data rows are found, and when row 3 does not hold the expected column names.

bugs.title: Template declares a range that hides its last two columns
bugs.cause: The generated sheet's dimension does not include the columns added last.
bugs.fix: Write the header row with the full column count so the dimension covers it.

bugs.title: Blank rows are staged as failed vendors
bugs.cause: Every row up to the last used row is staged.
bugs.fix: Skip rows whose cells are all empty.

bugs.title: A header with a leading space is not recognised
bugs.cause: Column names are trimmed on the right only (rstrip).
bugs.fix: strip instead of rstrip.

bugs.title: Error sheet with no failed rows says 'You are not allowed to change the phone number.'
bugs.cause: Error 487 is reused for 'no failed rows'.
bugs.fix: Add a dedicated error code and message.

bugs.title: Vendor Profile with a trailing space is refused
bugs.cause: The profile is compared without trimming (Status is trimmed at :199).
bugs.fix: Strip the value before comparing.

bugs.title: Invalid emails accepted (consecutive dots, over-long name part)
bugs.cause: VALID_EMAIL_REGEX allows [\w+\-.&]+ with no rule against '..' and no length limit.
bugs.fix: No leading, trailing or double dots; name part at most 64 characters.

bugs.title: Contactless also relaxes the manual Invite Vendor form
bugs.cause: contactless_vendor_record? checks only the workspace flag, and every invite path uses SendService.
bugs.fix: Limit the relaxation to the bulk worker (caller_type :worker).

bugs.title: A subsidiary created from a 'No' row still triggers the new-prospect mail
bugs.cause: The subsidiary invitation's other_details lacks skip_vendor_onboarding.
bugs.fix: Carry skip_vendor_onboarding into the subsidiary invitation.

bugs.title: The template endpoint serves users who may not upload
bugs.cause: bulk_create_vendor_template never calls authorize.
bugs.fix: authorize Company as the upload does.

bugs.title: Two uploads by the same user at the same time share one job id
bugs.cause: job_id = the user's distinct job count + 1, read before the insert.
bugs.fix: Use a sequence or a UUID for the job id.

bugs.title: The manual Invite form cannot tell two branches apart by pincode
bugs.cause: pincode is not a permitted parameter, so the incoming pincode is blank and a blank pincode counts as a match.
bugs.fix: Permit pincode (and send it from the form).

bugs.title: A correct GSTIN with a trailing space is rejected as "Invalid Tax No."
bugs.cause: verify_tax_no matches the raw cell (line_item["Tax No."].match?(regex)) against an anchored regex without trimming it, while the same service trims Status and the other fields (.to_s.strip). A space picked up when pasting into Excel makes a valid GSTIN fail.
bugs.fix: Strip (and upcase) Tax No. before the regex check and store the trimmed value in tax_no.
